Game Overview

At its heart, Zombie Counter Craft is a first-person shooter game about engage in an exhilarating fight for survival as you battle relentless zombie waves with limited ammo. Master quick reflexes and strategic planning to scavenge vital resources. Navigate an immersive apocalyptic world where every choice counts—how long can you survive against the undead?
